text:
Maya: quick sanity check — spotted a dead anchor in the runtime guide under 'prefix caching' (https://internal.docs.redwood.com/runtime/caching.md#prefix-caching). Smoke tests flagged 404s in the oncall run. Can someone take a quick look and either re-add the anchor or update the link?

Josh: thanks for the ping. I can take a look in ~30m. is there a specific example that broke?

Maya: cheers Josh. the failing test linked to a code sample anchor: `#prefix-cache-behavior` (I think prior rename removed the fragment). The file itself renders fine, just no fragment.

Priya: FYI the frontmatter linter sometimes rewrites headings during the build, that could have changed the anchor slug. I can run the local renderer to confirm.

Alex: @Josh @Priya if you find it's just an anchor slug change, easiest fix might be a one-line redirect in the doc frontmatter or update the failing test to point to the new slug. whichever is lower risk.

docs-bot: automated link-scan: /runtime/caching.md returns 200; fragment `#prefix-cache-behavior` -> 404. Suggested PR label: docs/low-risk.

Sam: assigning to Josh for quick PR; pinging docs-oncall for visibility. Sam -> Josh: can you add a short PR description noting the test flake and include screenshot from local render?

Josh: got it, will open PR with either a slug-safe heading or a tiny redirect. ETA 1hr.

Maya: perfect — if you want a reviewer, @Priya can do a quick pass on the heading and linter implications. thanks all :thumbsup:
